mechanism: Prednisolone may increase risk of cefepime-associated neurotoxicity (encephalopathy, seizures) through immunosuppression and CNS penetration; cephalosporins can also reduce prednisolone metabolism slightly.
action: Monitor for neurological symptoms (confusion, seizures, hallucinations) especially with renal impairment; ensure appropriate cefepime dosing for renal function; consider alternative antibiotic if high-dose prednisolone concurrent use.
